unosat.source_type: WorldView-3 satellite interpretation; preliminary, not field-validated
unosat.limitations: Public event folder returned no services. PDF has a cartographic analysis boundary, but no validated vector extent has been obtained for institution joins. No site was assigned a flood/damage label or an inside/outside analysis-coverage status.

context.limitations: JRC is static modeled river hazard, not 2022 observed water or future climate. Blank samples are unknown; 90 m is not building scale. CHIRPS is coarse regional rainfall.

omissions: Municipal boundary and historical floodplain geometry and derived overlap/distance results: redistribution rights unresolved.
Comparison figures, SAR overlays, municipal-mask context rasters and area-aggregated rainfall: municipal reference inputs; retained locally.
Identity-document excerpts and proposed identities: source redistribution terms unresolved.

rasters.label: JRC modeled river depth — 10-year
rasters.legend: 0–0.5 / 0.5–1 / 1–2 / 2–5 / ≥5 m; darker blue = deeper. Blank = no displayed depth, not safety. Permanent-water and suspected-artifact samples excluded.

rasters.label: JRC modeled river depth — 100-year
rasters.legend: 0–0.5 / 0.5–1 / 1–2 / 2–5 / ≥5 m; darker blue = deeper. Blank = no displayed depth, not safety. Permanent-water and suspected-artifact samples excluded.

rasters.label: JRC modeled river depth — 500-year
rasters.legend: 0–0.5 / 0.5–1 / 1–2 / 2–5 / ≥5 m; darker blue = deeper. Blank = no displayed depth, not safety. Permanent-water and suspected-artifact samples excluded.

rasters.label: JRC auxiliary flags
rasters.legend: Purple: permanent-water reference; amber: suspected model artifacts. These are not event observations.

rasters.label: CHIRPS 11–13 April 2022 total
rasters.legend: 0–100 mm: pale yellow to dark blue; values above 100 mm saturate. Regional gridded estimates, not building rainfall or climate attribution.

rasters.label: CHIRPS anomaly from 1991–2020 same-date mean
rasters.legend: −100 to +100 mm: brown = below, green = above same-date 1991–2020 mean; extremes saturate. Regional gridded estimates, not building rainfall or climate attribution.
